width.en: Measure the width of the table before choosing a cover.
width.zh: 選桌布前先量桌子的寬度。

wig.en: The actor wore a wig for the historical stage performance.
wig.zh: 演員在歷史舞台劇中戴了一頂假髮。

wilderness.en: The documentary explores wildlife living in a remote wilderness area.
wilderness.zh: 紀錄片探索生活在偏遠荒野地區的野生動物。

wildlife.en: The park protects wildlife by limiting access to sensitive areas.
wildlife.zh: 公園透過限制進入敏感區域來保護野生動物。

willing.en: She was willing to revise the report after receiving feedback.
willing.zh: 收到回饋後，她願意修改報告。

windshield.en: Rain covered the windshield during the afternoon drive.
windshield.zh: 下午開車時，雨水覆滿了擋風玻璃。

windy.en: It was too windy to hold the outdoor poster display.
windy.zh: 風太大，不適合舉辦戶外海報展示。

wing.en: The bird stretched one wing before taking off.
wing.zh: 那隻鳥起飛前伸展了一側翅膀。

wink.en: She gave a quick wink after solving the puzzle.
wink.zh: 她解開謎題後眨了一下眼。

wipe.en: Please wipe the whiteboard clean after the group discussion.
wipe.zh: 小組討論後請把白板擦乾淨。

wire.en: A loose wire caused the classroom speaker to stop working.
wire.zh: 一條鬆脫的電線讓教室喇叭停止運作。

wisdom.en: The story suggests that wisdom grows through experience and reflection.
wisdom.zh: 故事暗示智慧會隨經驗與反思而增長。

wit.en: Her quick wit made the class discussion more lively.
wit.zh: 她機智的反應讓課堂討論更活潑。

witch.en: The children read a fairy tale about a mysterious witch.
witch.zh: 孩子們讀了一則關於神祕女巫的童話。

wither.en: Plants may wither when they receive too little water.
wither.zh: 植物水分不足時可能會枯萎。

withhold.en: The editor decided to withhold the article until facts were verified.
withhold.zh: 編輯決定在查證事實前暫不刊登文章。

workout.en: A short workout can be part of a balanced daily routine.
workout.zh: 短時間運動可以成為均衡日常作息的一部分。

workshop.en: The school hosted a writing workshop for interested students.
workshop.zh: 學校為有興趣的學生舉辦寫作工作坊。

worm.en: A worm moved slowly across the wet garden soil.
worm.zh: 一條蚯蚓慢慢爬過潮濕的花園土壤。

worse.en: The traffic became worse after the heavy rain began.
worse.zh: 大雨開始後，交通狀況變得更糟。

worship.en: The course examines how different cultures worship in varied traditions.
worship.zh: 這門課探討不同文化如何以各自傳統進行敬拜。

worst.en: The worst delay occurred during the evening rush hour.
worst.zh: 最嚴重的延誤發生在晚間尖峰時段。

worthwhile.en: The extra practice was difficult but ultimately worthwhile.
worthwhile.zh: 額外練習雖然困難，但最後證明很值得。

worthy.en: The judges considered the project worthy of special recognition.
worthy.zh: 評審認為這項專題值得特別表揚。

wound.en: The story mentions a minor wound without giving graphic details.
wound.zh: 故事提到一處輕微傷口，但沒有描述血腥細節。

diffusion.en: The science lesson used food coloring to demonstrate diffusion in water.
diffusion.zh: 自然課用食用色素示範水中的擴散現象。

dignify.en: A respectful response can dignify even a difficult public discussion.
dignify.zh: 有禮的回應能讓艱難的公共討論更有尊嚴。

dignitary.en: A visiting dignitary attended the opening ceremony at the museum.
dignitary.zh: 一位來訪貴賓出席了博物館的開幕典禮。

disapproval.en: The committee expressed disapproval of the poorly supported proposal.
disapproval.zh: 委員會對缺乏充分支持的提案表示不贊同。

disbelieve.en: Readers may disbelieve a claim that lacks reliable evidence.
disbelieve.zh: 讀者可能不相信缺乏可靠證據的主張。

disco.en: The music exhibit includes a section about disco culture.
disco.zh: 音樂展覽中有一區介紹迪斯可文化。

discontent.en: Public discontent increased when services repeatedly failed to improve.
discontent.zh: 服務屢次沒有改善時，大眾不滿逐漸增加。

discouraging.en: The first test result was discouraging, but the team kept improving.
discouraging.zh: 第一次測試結果令人沮喪，但團隊仍持續改進。

discrepancy.en: The researcher noticed a discrepancy between the two data sets.
discrepancy.zh: 研究者注意到兩組資料之間存在差異。

discretion.en: Teachers may use discretion when adjusting deadlines for special circumstances.
discretion.zh: 遇到特殊情況時，老師可自行斟酌調整期限。

disgusting.en: The character described the spoiled food as disgusting.
disgusting.zh: 角色形容腐壞的食物令人噁心。

dishwasher.en: The restaurant replaced an old dishwasher with a newer model.
dishwasher.zh: 餐廳用較新的機型替換了舊洗碗機。

disinterested.en: A disinterested judge should evaluate both sides fairly.
disinterested.zh: 公正無私的裁判應公平評估雙方。

dismantle.en: Workers will dismantle the temporary stage after the festival.
dismantle.zh: 工作人員會在活動後拆除臨時舞台。

disorganized.en: The notes looked disorganized until she sorted them by topic.
disorganized.zh: 她依主題整理前，這些筆記看起來很凌亂。

dispel.en: Clear evidence can dispel a rumor before it spreads further.
dispel.zh: 清楚的證據可以在謠言進一步擴散前加以澄清。

displacement.en: The report examines population displacement after a major natural disaster.
displacement.zh: 報告探討重大天然災害後的人口遷移。

displease.en: The unexpected schedule change may displease some participants.
displease.zh: 突如其來的行程變更可能讓部分參與者不滿。

disposition.en: Her calm disposition helped the group work through disagreements.
disposition.zh: 她沉著的性情幫助團隊處理意見分歧。

disqualify.en: Breaking the competition rules may disqualify a team from the event.
disqualify.zh: 違反比賽規則可能使隊伍失去參賽資格。

disregard.en: Drivers should not disregard warning signs near construction zones.
disregard.zh: 駕駛不應忽視施工區附近的警告標誌。

dissatisfaction.en: The survey revealed dissatisfaction with the limited library hours.
dissatisfaction.zh: 調查顯示大家對圖書館開放時間有限感到不滿。

dissatisfy.en: Unclear instructions can dissatisfy users of an online service.
dissatisfy.zh: 不清楚的說明可能讓線上服務使用者感到不滿。

dissident.en: The history text describes a dissident who challenged government policy peacefully.
dissident.zh: 歷史課文描述一位以和平方式挑戰政府政策的異議人士。

dissuade.en: Strong evidence may dissuade the group from adopting a weak proposal.
dissuade.zh: 有力證據可能使團隊打消採用薄弱提案的念頭。
